text: The tenderer must hold electrical contracting rights (sahkourakointioikeudet) of at least class S2.
The tenderer must have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 300,000.
Environmental management arrangements during the course of the work.
Content of the proposed HVAC system maintenance agreement.
Limitation of liability clause proposed by the tenderer.
A tenderer intending to use subcontractors must complete and attach the Subcontractor List (Appendix 3).
The tender must be submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.
Price must be quoted in EUR/m2/year, not EUR/month.
Tenders must be submitted via the municipality's electronic tender submission system by 15 May 2026, 12:00 (Helsinki time). Late tenders will not be opened.
Content and timing of the maintenance visit schedule.
Waste management and on-site sorting of waste arising from the works.
Description of the tenderer's environmental management system, to be attached to the tender.
